notes: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B (fp8) + the lightx2v 4-step LoRA: the character of the reference image sings or speaks the audio clip (lip sync, head and body motion), 16 fps. One generation covers `length` frames (77 = 4.8 s); `chunks` > 1 chains WanSoundImageToVideoExtend steps the way the official template does (3 = 14.4 s), each with the next seed. Prospero cuts the audio clip (from audio_start_s, audio_seconds long) with ffmpeg and uploads it; the video keeps that audio (the cut uses the song). Converted from the official video_wan2_2_14B_s2v.json template through the real 0.37 frontend; its two extend subgraphs are rebuilt by comfy_driver.expand_chunks.
